description: Reads the project to find every 2D art asset it needs and produces a checklist: what exists, what is missing, what is placeholder. Produces a list, never the images themselves.
when_to_use: the request is 'what art do we still need'
a generation run needs a list to work from
art coverage across the project is unknown
avoid_when: the list already exists and the request is to produce the images
the assets in question are interface, effect, model or animation assets
inputs: the art bible when there is one
outputs: art asset checklist with gaps marked
